baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth noun and passive MDD predicate in 84:3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The lower surface is drawn lengthwise until prior relief and limits yield to a continuous expanse.

activation_trace.role: Ground as the lower surface opposite the sky supplies the plane whose shape is altered.
Lengthwise drawing until continuity supplies the flattening and widening operation.

changed_reading.after: The earth's lower plane is pulled into continuous breadth, stressing removal of interruption rather than mere increase in size.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth branch that names a thick mat combined with the focus verb's drawing image.
baseline_models.mechanism: Earth behaves like a thick folded furnishing put under tension and deployed as one broad surface.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat image supplies a material model for a surface that can be unrolled.
Drawing lengthwise supplies the action that deploys and tensions the mat-like ground.

changed_reading.before: The event changes the earth's dimensions abstractly.
changed_reading.after: The event materially unfurls the earth like a heavy mat, converting folds and thickness into available surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Fertile earth and the supply and swelling branches of MDD in the focus inventories.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive extension may occur by connected material or flowing supply feeding the ground, not only by traction from its edges.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies a receptive substrate capable of enlargement and renewed growth.
Connected increase that sustains another supplies an additive cause for the earth's extension.
Water swelling because other water feeds it supplies a fluid model of increased capacity.

changed_reading.before: The earth is stretched by an external pull.
changed_reading.after: The earth is enlarged through connected provision, as a receptive ground swells when fed by added material or flow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal-term branch of the focus predicate remains attached to the earth subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Spatial extension carries a secondary temporal resonance: the earth's own span or tenure is drawn out to its full limit.

activation_trace.role: The earth as the lower world supplies the entity whose duration can be considered.
An extended term, deadline, or respite supplies the temporal dimension of MDD.

changed_reading.before: Only the earth's surface is lengthened.
changed_reading.after: Alongside spatial widening, the earth's allotted span is heard as being drawn to full extension.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mat-like earth and ink-supplying MDD branches in 84:3.
baseline_models.mechanism: A broad mat-like surface coupled with an ink-supply image weakly suggests a field prepared to receive visible marks.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat supplies a broad material substrate on which marks could be displayed.
The inkwell supplying a pen gives extension a latent inscription channel.

changed_reading.before: The newly broad earth is only a physical expanse.
changed_reading.after: The broad earth can also be sensed as a prepared display or writing field, though the focus alone leaves that activation weak.

context_deltas.mechanism: The upper canopy opens while the lower plane is drawn wide; accepted command and binding obligation make the two changes a coordinated release of the world's enclosing boundaries.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground opposite the sky supplies one boundary of the paired enclosure.
Lengthwise drawing into continuity supplies the release of the lower boundary.
The sky as what rises and shades supplies the upper canopy paired with the lower ground.
Fissuring and opening supplies the canopy's mode of boundary failure.
Listening and accepting what is heard makes the cosmic change responsive rather than accidental.
Binding obligation supplies the necessity governing the paired transformations.

structural_cues: The sky and earth clauses are parallel conditional openings, and 84:2 and 84:5 repeat the same response formula.
Earth is explicitly the lower term opposite the sky in its own focus inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upper canopy, a lower ground, opening, extension, acceptance, and obligation; I supply the arrow that treats them as coordinated dismantling of one enclosure. They could instead be independent signs linked only by parallel syntax.

changed_reading.before: The earth independently flattens into a larger plane.
changed_reading.after: The lower plane is tensioned open as the upper canopy splits, jointly removing the old world's enclosing geometry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's confrontation or coming-forward branch turns extension into full self-presentation: every part is made available under lordship, then the earth accepts that binding demand.

activation_trace.role: Coming forward in exposure or confrontation supplies an active posture latent in the earth noun.
Continuous extension makes the earth's presentation spatially exhaustive.
Attentive acceptance supplies the earth's responsive agency immediately after its actions.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the relation under which the earth presents itself.
A fixed obligation makes the presentation due rather than voluntary display.

structural_cues: The earth remains the understood feminine subject through 84:4 and is followed by its own obedience refrain in 84:5.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, exhaustive extension, acceptance, sovereignty, and duty; I infer that being spread is the earth's way of presenting itself fully. A live alternative is simple personification after a wholly passive physical change.

changed_reading.before: The earth is an inert object stretched by another power.
changed_reading.after: While still acted upon, the earth also comes forward in total exposure, making its whole surface available to the command it accepts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fertile ground is expanded by connected supply and flowing water; repair, nourishment, incoming flow, abundance, and fitness allow a constructive reconstitution reading to coexist with destructive flattening.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive material being reconditioned.
Connected increase that sustains another supplies provisioning as the cause of extension.
Water fed by more water supplies the swelling and circulation mechanism.
Repair, cultivation, and completion supply a constructive governing action.
The non-dominant mapped branch of nourishment and growth keeps a form-distant regenerative route live.
A watercourse opened into a traversable channel supplies directed incoming flow.
Abundance of water and pasture supplies the possible outcome of provisioned ground.
Fitness and suitability supply the endpoint of reconstituting the ground for another use.

structural_cues: The surah contains ease, return to one's people, completion, and an uncut reward alongside rupture and punishment.
The focus verb is passive, leaving traction and provisioning as competing possible mechanisms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fertile ground, connected provision, water flow, repair, growth, abundance, and fitness; I assign the earth as recipient and infer reconstitution. Those positive branch images may instead belong only to their local human and cosmic contexts, leaving flattening destructive.

changed_reading.before: Extension destroys the old terrain by flattening it.
changed_reading.after: Extension may simultaneously provision and recondition the ground into a larger, fertile, fit substrate for a changed order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Drawing the earth into a continuous plane is coupled to casting out its contents and becoming bare, so spatial extension also reverses its function from container to exposed display.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies both the surface and the container whose state changes.
Drawing into continuity supplies the flattening that removes hiding places and interior relief.
Casting a thing out supplies the earth's unloading operation.
Bareness and vacancy supply the resulting empty state.

structural_cues: 84:3-4 form one earth-subject chain: extension, casting out what is within, and becoming empty.
The sequence names both a surface transformation and a containment reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extension, ejection, and vacancy; I infer that flattening enables or constitutes decontainment. The verbs could instead name simultaneous effects with no causal order.

changed_reading.before: The earth's exterior is geometrically flattened.
changed_reading.after: The earth is decontained: its terrain is opened into a continuous display plane while its interior is expelled and left vacant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mat and ink seed in the focus becomes a forensic surface: human toil scratches, writing fixes an account, exteriority exposes it, distinguishing marks make it legible, and stored matter is externalized.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat supplies an unrolled substrate for displaying traces.
The inkwell supplying a pen gives MDD an inscription mechanism.
A scratch or bite leaving a trace turns human toil into marks impressed on a substrate.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the explicit record form.
The earth's visible exterior supplies the display face on which the record can appear.
A distinguishing trace that guides recognition supplies legibility and identification.
Gathering something inside a vessel supplies the stored material later exposed from the earth-container.

structural_cues: Two opposed recipients receive written records, while the earth has already cast out what it contained.
The later knowledge statement targets what people gather and retain internally.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mat, ink supply, scratches, writing, an exterior surface, identifying marks, and stored contents; I identify the extended earth as the common display substrate. A live alternative is that it only exposes records located elsewhere rather than itself bearing them.

changed_reading.before: The earth is unrolled only to make physical room.
changed_reading.after: The earth is unrolled as a legible forensic field on which stored traces of human labor become externally readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch naming a dry measure combines with counting, apportionment, and a weighed amount: extension converts irregular hidden volume into a standardized, assessable extent.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the field whose extent can be assessed.
The known mudd measure gives the focus predicate a latent calibration image.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative operation applied to the calibrated field.
Separating and distributing shares supplies apportionment across the measured extent.
A weighed amount supplies a second, independent measurement image.

structural_cues: The focus precedes account, written record, differentiated outcomes, and a final reward statement.
Flattening changes a volumetric, occluded terrain into a surveyable plane.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a named measure, accounting, allocation, and weight; I infer that extension makes the earth commensurable for assessment. The measure branches may be lexical side channels with no shared operation in the verse.

changed_reading.before: Extension makes the earth visually broad.
changed_reading.after: Extension also makes the earth calibratable: concealed irregularity becomes one assessable and apportionable extent.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning, returning, gathering, attaining coherence, superimposition, and state-after-state recast earth-extension as one phase in a reversible sequence of folding, collecting, and redeploying layers.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat supplies a layer capable of folding and redeployment.
Lengthwise drawing supplies the deployed phase of the layer.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies inversion between surface states.
Return and diminution supply reversibility rather than a final static endpoint.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the compressed phase opposite earth's spreading.
Completion and even coherence supply the phase in which gathered parts attain a whole.
One thing mounted over another supplies the mechanics of superimposed layers.
State after state supplies the explicit succession through which the earth's deployment is reread.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves from twilight through night-gathering and lunar coherence to layer after layer.
Return language appears between the initial earth transformation and the later phase sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inversion, return, gathering, coherence, superimposition, and successive states; I supply a shared fold-and-unfold mechanics and place earth-extension within it. These may instead be analogies of change without a common material cycle.

changed_reading.before: The earth is flattened once into a final static plane.
changed_reading.after: The earth's layer is unfurled as one transition within a larger sequence that gathers, turns, stacks, and redeploys states.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus predicate's extended-term branch is sharpened by return or diminution, a layer that can be a portion of time, and an explicit image of cutting and reducing until extension ceases.

activation_trace.role: Earth as the lower world supplies the entity whose tenure is being tracked.
An extended term or deadline supplies the temporal reading directly from the focus predicate.
Return and diminution supply movement toward the end of a granted span.
A layer understood as a portion of time locates extension within successive temporal segments.
Cutting and diminishing until extension stops supplies the exact terminal counterforce to MDD.

structural_cues: The surah moves through successive conditions and closes by negating interruption of reward.
The focus's passive perfect can mark a threshold reached as well as a physical operation completed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extended time, return or loss, temporal layers, and cessation of extension; I apply those to the earth's tenure and infer that its allotted span reaches a boundary. The earth subject still makes spatial extension the dominant grammatical reading.

changed_reading.before: The earth's dimensions alone are drawn out.
changed_reading.after: The earth's allotted duration is also heard as fully paid out, arriving at the cutoff where its former state can no longer continue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses medically distant branches of both focus roots and later cues. It remains anchored in the earth and MDD inventories, with scratch, wound-filling, and skin-removal branches converging on one material mechanism. Render it only as an exploratory bodily analogy, never as a claim that the surface words lexically mean wound or pus.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The festering-sore branch of earth and wound-exudation branch of MDD attach the bodily analogy directly to both content roots of 84:3.

activation_trace.role: A sore corrupted by accumulated pus lets the earth be modeled as damaged tissue.
A wound producing pus turns extension into pressure, exudation, and opening rather than neutral geometry.
A scratch or bite mark supplies the injury channel linking human toil to the earth-body.
A wound filling with pus supplies hidden accumulation within the injured container.
Removing skin from a surface supplies the final exposure of what had accumulated beneath it.

changed_reading.before: A neutral ground surface is stretched and emptied.
changed_reading.after: Earth is pulled open like damaged tissue, discharging and exposing what accumulated beneath its skin.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context begins with splitting and the focus usually suggests widening, yet the focus MDD branch itself ends in connection and several later branches independently converge on joining fractures. Keep it as a counter-reading of material repair, qualified as analogy rather than a lexical equation of extension with healing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus operation draws something lengthwise until it connects, while the earth supplies the ground across which separated margins could be bridged.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the material field whose separated margins can be rejoined.
Drawing lengthwise until connection supplies a bridging rather than merely separating action.
The opening fissure supplies the break against which the earth's connective extension is contrasted.
Thickening an edge and joining two clefts supplies a concrete suturing operation.
Bone knitting after fracture supplies an organic repair analogue.
Setting a crooked break supplies deliberate structural correction.
Reconciliation that removes estrangement supplies the social analogue of joining separated sides.

changed_reading.before: Earth-extension only tears down or flattens the old terrain.
changed_reading.after: The ground may be drawn across ruptures as a bridging layer, tensioned until separated margins form a repaired continuity.

strongest_changes: Sky-opening and earth-extension became a paired release of upper and lower boundaries.
The following ejection and vacancy changed flattening into a reversal from container to exposed display plane.
Toil, writing, visible marks, and stored contents activated the earth as a forensic inscription field.
Supply, water, growth, and fitness preserved a constructive fertile-ground reading alongside rupture.
Layer, measure, and cutoff branches kept spatial, procedural, and temporal readings simultaneously live.
summary.what_was_special: The same two focus roots sustained opposed mechanisms without forcing a choice: exposure and renewed capacity, wound and repair, unrolled matter and written record, spatial breadth and exhausted duration.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive MDD predicate does not decide whether extension occurs by traction, added supply, or both.
Writing, measurement, wound, repair, and temporal models depend on branch-distant analogies even where several cues converge.
The coordinated verse sequence supports causal readings but does not prove whether extension enables ejection or merely accompanies it.
